data.name: Rehanah
data.gender_notes: Rehanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is content with the pleasure of Allah and the joy of being a Muslim. The name Rehanah carries the meaning “Contentment, pleasure, joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rehanah usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, pleasure, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is content with her faith and the pleasure of Allah
data.etymology: Rehanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment, pleasure, joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehanah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rehanah suggests a deep connection to Islamic values of contentment and gratitude towards Allah. In Islamic culture, Rehanah could be viewed as an individual who is at peace with their faith and life. The name may also be appreciated as a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth and inner contentment, which can lead to happiness and fulfillment in life.
data.spiritual_significance: Rehanah is a name that symbolizes the spiritual journey of an individual who is devoted to Allah (God) and finds contentment in their faith. This name underscores the pursuit of inner peace, happiness, and fulfillment through a deep connection with God. It serves as a constant reminder that true happiness is found in pleasing Allah and being grateful for the blessings that come with being a Muslim.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Contentment, pleasure, joy" symbolizes The one who is content with the pleasure of Allah and the joy of being a Muslim.
